facts.material: neodymium-iron-boron permanent magnet in a rubber cap
facts.function: holds/stores keys by magnetic attachment to metal surfaces
facts.form: finished article: rubber cap plus NdFeB magnet

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8505 covers permanent magnets and articles intended to become permanent magnets; Section XVI/chapter 85 notes do not exclude
GRI 3(b): rubber cap is a mere housing, magnet gives essential character
GRI 6: 8505.11 of metal (NdFeB) over 8505.19; statistical line sintered neodymium-iron-boron

rejected_alternatives.reason: magnet is rigid NdFeB metal, not flexible magnetized rubber

missing_facts: whether the NdFeB magnet is sintered (assumed)
classification.rationale: Rare-earth NdFeB magnet in a rubber cap is a permanent magnet of metal under 8505.11 (cf. R00586 armband with N40 neodymium magnets, in force); sintered NdFeB assumed.
